title: nemophila menziesii subsp. integrifolia
intro: Nemophila menziesii subsp. integrifolia, commonly known as Baby Blue Eyes, is a flowering plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is native to the western United States and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant has been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Baby Blue Eyes include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, although further research is needed to confirm their specific effects.
